description: Everything waiting for you: unread mail, notifications, shares to accept and Talk conversations. Sequence (built in): runs these steps in one call, as you: 1. list_mailboxes; 2. list_notifications; 3. list_pending_shares; 4. talk_list_conversations. Steps whose tool you do not have are skipped. Pass dryRun: true to see the resolved plan without running it.
